text_block_list.text:
Today, as I was training with <chrname> on the 
simulator once again—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Alright, goal.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Let's do one cooldown lap, and 
then take a break.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Let's move forward one step at a time, 
without rushing.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. ......I'm going to go cool down.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Um, thank you very much for joining me for 
training.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"So, what do you think...? I feel like 
Meek's condition and growth have been 
lagging a bit..."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"There's no need to look so worried. Those 
watching over her need to stay strong 
first."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: —Wait, oh my.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
No, rather than a problem... I just feel 
like Meek's condition hasn't really been 
improving lately.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We were discussing what the cause might 
be—whether the training was too light, or 
if we were having her do something 
completely unsuited for her in the first 
place...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how about we sort out our thoughts 
first? Now, everyone, take a nice, deep 
breath~.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"And about Meek-chan, there are no issues 
with her training regimen."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"And Bitter Glasse has real potential, 
too. An abundance of data guarantees it."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... What a relief. Even so, the fact 
that my condition isn't improving...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Does that mean they're a late bloomer 
after all?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see... Considering her current 
physique and the trend of her lap times 
since hitting her stride—"

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"When grouping past Umamusume with similar 
data to those, they generally tend to be 
late bloomers."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
In other words, there's a high chance Meek 
is a late bloomer too. Your intuition was 
right on the mark.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...! Phew... Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help but wonder if I'm not good 
enough for Meek...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you are doing a fine job watching 
over them.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"So right now, let's not rush or press 
her, and just watch over Little Meek."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: "...Yes! I'll do my best!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Good work, Meek.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. ......Thank you for your hard 
work.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Mejiro Bright. I'd like to discuss 
our policy going forward.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: "...Oh. ......I'm excited."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
First, many Umamusume will now begin 
making their moves with next year's 
Classic races in their sights.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Still, every Umamusume has her own pace, 
and Meek has her own pace too.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And I felt that it wasn't something to be 
compared with others. So, um...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Let's take things at Meek's pace! It might 
take time, but we'll be thorough and not 
rush...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: M-Meek...?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, understood.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure? I might not make it in 
time for the big Classic stage—

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...No problem. ............At our own 
pace.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek...! I'll support you with everything 
I have! Because you're definitely going to 
bloom, Meek!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best, at our own pace!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll do my best. ............Hip, hip, 
hip, hooray."

Trainer Kiryuin is determined to believe 
in Happy Meek's potential and continue 
supporting her wholeheartedly.

She felt that Godolphin Barb, giving both 
of them a push forward, was a very kind 
and reassuring presence.
